ana: Quick follow-up from the multi-region sync: ops wants a concise, machine-evaluable definition for auto-switchback that also enforces residency. can we land something operator-friendly?

michael: TL;DR: two independent gates must be true for auto-switchback: SAFETY (no split-brain risk) + POLICY (residency/legal). both must pass.

sree: From runtime we can provide reliable signals: runtime.last_applied_seq{tenant,region}, runtime.inflight_leases{tenant,region}, runtime.ingress_queue_len{tenant,region}, region_time_drift_ms{pair}. Proposal thresholds: seq_delta<=1 sustained for 45s, inflight_leases==0, ingress_queue_len==0, drift<500ms.

yara: Policy gate comes from control plane flags: tenant.residency_mode in {hard,preferred,none} and tenant.allow_cross_region_writes boolean. If residency_mode==hard and target-region != resident-region -> block auto-switchback.

ana: (ops) we want a single composite gauge to make alerts trivial. can we emit region_switchback_eligibility{tenant,region}=1/0 with a reason label (caught_up, policy_block, inflight, drift, operator_lock)?

michael: yes. also emit counters switchback.attempts and switchback.fail_reasons. add last_switchback_ts and switchback_cooldown_until per-tenant so dashboards show cooldown state.

sree: Edge-cases: nondeterministic side-effects (webhooks, external callbacks) must disable auto-switchback by default. introduce tenant.requires_deterministic_replay flag; if true -> auto_switchback=disabled unless manual-override used.

yara: Runbook (compact):
- check tenant.residency_mode and tenant.allow_cross_region_writes
- verify region_switchback_eligibility==1 for >=45s
- confirm runtime_inflight_leases==0 and ingress_queue_len==0
- run deterministic canary (3 idempotent read/writes) and compare state hashes
- flip primary, set tenant.switchback_cooldown_until = now + 30m
- monitor error rate and tail latency for 10m

ana: CLI emergency override (audit required):
```bash
redwoodctl tenant switchback --tenant acme-corp --target-region eu-west-1 --force-override --reason "legal-escalation-1234"
```
Note: --force-override only for support-admins and records audit log + ticket ID.

michael: Additional safety: if caught_up not achieved within 10m after failover, mark tenant.auto_switchback = manual and notify legal/ops. we prefer failing closed.

sree: Implementation plan: runtime to export the 4 metrics + composite gauge, control plane to add flags (allow_cross_region_writes, requires_deterministic_replay, auto_switchback_mode, cooldown), ops to add CLI example and audit requirement, SRE to create heatmap dashboard for seq_delta over time. canary target: small PLG tenant next week.

yara: Telemetry names sketch: runtime_last_applied_seq_seconds (histogram), runtime_seq_delta_gauge, runtime_inflight_leases_gauge, runtime_ingress_queue_gauge, region_switchback_eligibility_gauge, switchback_attempts_total, switchback_fail_reasons_total. label with tenant_tier and resident_region.

oncall-bot: notice: observed failover tenant=acme-corp at 2026-03-28T02:14:01Z, duration=11m, seq_delta=3, residency_mode=preferred, region_switchback_eligibility=0 reason=inflight

ana: OK I'll draft the runbook PR (include CLI snippet and audit flow). owners: eng=sree, controlplane=yara, ops=ana, sre=michael. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
